task.title: Add a note to a person
task.shortdesc: Write down something you know about a person that does not fit in a date or a place, and use one note for several people.

prereq.p: Open the person first. shows how.

step.cmd: Choose under Add a note to the person, then choose at the bottom.

stepresult.p: A form opens with a box for the note.

info.p: Write what you know. Say where you read it if you can.

step.cmd: Choose in the bar along the bottom, then .

stepresult.p: The note shows in the list of notes for that person.

result.p: To use a note you have already written for another person, open the second person. Choose , then , then . Search for the note and choose it. Each note shows how many records use it. The note then says that it is shared with another record.
The button on the same screen writes a new note for the person you have open.
